note: Small Kapso workflow. The agent sends WhatsApp replies through platform tools. The only custom tool asks a human team on Slack and resumes on 'done'. No database, no UI, no mock data.

labels.what: The agent can send customer WhatsApp messages (send_notification_to_user) and finish the task on its own when 'confident'. A human sees the case only if the model chooses to ask the team or hand off

Prompt says answer directly only when confident and hand off to a human if it cannot be resolved safely. No code checks confidence or topic. The one-question-per-run limit is enforced by the tool (reuses the open question), but the confidence rule is prompt only
ask_team_question posts model-written question, title and summary plus the customer phone number to Slack with no length cap or sanitising. Capped only to one open question per run
The Slack url_verification branch skips the signature check when the signature headers are missing or the secret is unset. It only returns the challenge, so low impact

The answer sent back to the agent is every non-bot reply in the thread, with no check that the author is an approved team member. Anyone in the Slack channel can steer the customer reply. Text goes into the model as guidance (prompt-injection path)
If resume fails with 404 or 422 the error is swallowed and the question is still marked answered, so a lost answer is not retried
Default model name openai/gpt-5.4 hardcoded (env override exists in workflow.ts line 77)
maxIterations 80, maxTokens 8192, temperature 0.2 and reasoningEffort fixed in code
